slides.title: Spoken Tutorial on First Project
slides.narration: Welcome to this Spoken Tutorial on **First Project**.

slides.title: Learning Objectives
slides.narration:
In this tutorial, you will learn to,
• Define the goal of our first **AI** project.
• Set up a **Gemini** development environment.
• Create and refine **prompts** for the **Gemini API**.
• Compare basic and improved **AI** responses.

slides.title: System Requirements
slides.narration: Here I am using a browser on a computer or mobile.

slides.title: Pre-requisites
slides.narration: To follow this tutorial, you should have completed Episode 1 and 2 of this Module.

slides.title: What is Our First Project?
slides.narration:
Our first project uses the **Gemini API**.
We will generate creative content with it.
Imagine a chef learning to use a new kitchen appliance.
They want to create a delicious new dish.
Similarly, we will learn to use **Gemini** to create.
slides.image_prompt: Person at laptop, illustration showing Gemini API and creative content generation with a chef in a kitchen

slides.title: Setting Up Your Workspace
slides.narration:
Let's set up our workspace.
First, open **Google Colab**.
Then, install the necessary **Python** packages.
Finally, securely paste your **Gemini API** key.
This key grants access to the **API**.
slides.image_prompt: Browser showing Google Colab interface, with code for installing Python packages and pasting API key

slides.title: Initializing the Gemini Model
slides.narration:
Now, initialize the **Gemini** model.
Import the **Gemini** library in **Colab**.
Configure your **AI** model.
Call the initialization function.
Use your **API** key for this step.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: code in Google Colab showing Gemini library import and model initialization

slides.title: Creating a Basic Prompt
slides.narration:
Let's create a basic **prompt**.
Define a simple product topic.
For example, 'a unique gift for a friend'.
Craft an open-ended **prompt** for the **AI**.
Observe how simple this initial **prompt** is.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user typing 'a unique gift for a friend...' into a prompt input field

slides.title: Sending the Request & Seeing the First Response
slides.narration:
Send your basic **prompt** to the **Gemini API**.
The **API** processes your request.
Then, display the initial **AI** response.
See this response directly in your **Colab** notebook.
Notice the content generated by the **AI**.
slides.image_prompt: AI generating response on screen in Google Colab

slides.title: Improving Your Prompt
slides.narration:
Now, improve your **prompt**.
Add more specific details.
Include constraints and examples.
This guides the **AI** towards a better output.
See how adding detail changes the request.
slides.image_prompt: Screen close-up: user refining a prompt by adding specific details and constraints

slides.title: Comparing Responses
slides.narration:
Compare the two **AI** responses.
Look at the basic **prompt** response.
Then, look at the improved **prompt** response.
Notice the impact of **prompt engineering**.
See the difference in quality and relevance.
slides.image_prompt: Side-by-side: basic prompt output vs improved prompt output

slides.title: Summary
slides.narration:
Let us summarize what we learned.
We set up our environment.
We initialized the **Gemini** model.
We learned to create and refine **prompts**.
This helps get better **AI** responses.

slides.title: Assignment
slides.narration:
Now as an assignment,
use these techniques.
Generate a creative product description.
Do this for a hypothetical new gadget.
Compare the results.
